title: Voxel2Mesh
family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
paper_title: Voxel2Mesh: 3D Mesh Model Generation from Volumetric Data
core_mech: Voxel2Mesh 不先分割再 marching cubes，而由 3D 体素特征逐级驱动球形模板的 GCN 形变和细分。
core_mech_en: Deforms a sphere template mesh progressively into a target 3D anatomical surface via Graph Convolutions conditioned on 3D CNN voxel features sampled at mesh vertices.
input_desc: 3D 医学体积与初始球形模板 mesh
input_en: 3D medical imaging volume (CT/MRI/EM) + initial genus-0 spherical template mesh
output_desc: 器官表面的顶点、三角面与可选体素分割
output_en: Explicit 3D anatomical triangle mesh (vertices V, faces F) and auxiliary voxel segmentation

source.title: Voxel2Mesh

gaps: Voxel2Mesh needs its deformable mesh initialization, graph-convolution refinement, adaptive unpooling and mesh losses. The graph classification lessons are not substitutes; the original GPL source remains linked.
